jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate
jobs.description:
Job Scope

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.

The Manufacturing Associate performs all functions associated with manufacturing operations. This includes operating process machines and auxiliary equipment, troubleshooting, and maintaining the machine. The manufacturing associate is also expected to collaborate with colleagues and engineers on tasks including (but not restricted to): set-up, calibration, rework, material handling, sampling and experiments. This role requires technical understanding of the manufacturing process and uses custom programs to support the collection of operating data to make real-time adjustments to processes, instruments or equipment. The manufacturing associate will assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process and improve shop floor management.  

Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)

    Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections.

    Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time. Working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 

    Operate the process machines and material handling equipment used in production, following implemented work instructions, standard operating procedures, and guidelines.

    Perform troubleshooting, autonomous maintenance, cleaning activities and pre-start up inspections/safety checks on production and material handling equipment and fixtures.

    Support the review and optimization of work instructions and process documentation.

    Train and validate the competence of new manufacturing associates.

    Assist with the distribution and handling/re-stocking of PPE and shop floor consumables.

    Handle production waste.

    Report current condition, status and also deviations in machine function, area cleanliness or personnel behavior to shift leader.

    Contribute to maintaining high 5S standards within the process areas and general factory areas.

    Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for cleaning, material handling, waste handling, and PPE use.

    Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process.

    Work proactively with the support functions (Manufacturing technicians, quality, logistics, etc).

    Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resources for the benefit of the business.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Qualifications and Experience

    High school education or a relevant education (e.g., industrial program at a gymnasium level, automation operator/technician education, process operator/technician education) is a plus.

    1 year previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).

    Experience with some of the following is advantageous: permit procedures, Lock Out Tag Out, near-miss reporting, safety audits, maintenance audits, process control systems, and daily follow-up on safety actions.

    Understanding how to utilize equipment to run efficient manufacturing with energy and costing optimization.
    Experience with production processes including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic components.

Specific skills & Knowledge  

    Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.

    Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.

    High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  

    This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 

    A genuine technical interest and curiosity about working within production is highly valued. A good understanding of machines and equipment such as pipes, pumps, and valves is a plus.

jobs.title: Produktionstekniker - FLIR!
jobs.description:
Gillar du att skruva, justera och lösa problem när en maskin inte beter sig som den ska? Då kan det här vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

WeStaff Sweden söker nu en tekniskt nyfiken och praktiskt lagd person till FLIR i Täby. Här får du en vardag där du är nära maskinerna, produktionen och människorna som arbetar med dem.

Det här är en roll för dig som hellre tar fram verktygslådan än sitter still framför ett skrivbord. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början, det viktiga är att du tycker om teknik, vill förstå hur saker fungerar och gillar att hitta lösningar.

Om FLIR

På FLIR i Täby tillverkas avancerade optiska komponenter som används i bland annat värmekameror och andra produkter inom avancerad sensorteknik.

Som Produktionstekniker blir du en del av den dagliga produktionen och arbetar med utrustningen som gör tillverkningen möjlig. Ena stunden kan du behöva undersöka varför en maskin stannat, nästa stund justera en komponent eller hjälpa en operatör att få igång utrustningen igen.

En stor del av rollen handlar om att vara nyfiken och metodisk: Vad har hänt? Varför händer det? Vad behöver justeras eller åtgärdas för att maskinen ska fungera igen?

Du arbetar både med planerat underhåll och med problem som behöver lösas här och nu. Samtidigt får du möjlighet att lära dig mer om avancerade maskiner och processer inom precisionsproduktion.

En vardag nära tekniken

I rollen kommer du bland annat att arbeta med:

    

Felsökning när produktionsutrustning inte fungerar som den ska

    

Förebyggande underhåll och enklare service

    

Justering och byte av mekaniska komponenter

    

Mekanik, pneumatik och enklare el

    

CNC-maskiner och annan precisionsutrustning

    

Slip-, poler- och rengöringsutrustning

    

Kontroller och funktionskontroller av maskiner

    

Dokumentation av underhåll och genomförda åtgärder

    

Installation och uppstart av ny utrustning

    

Förbättringar av maskiner, arbetssätt och processer

    

Teknisk support till operatörer och produktion

Du kommer alltså inte att göra samma sak varje dag. Rollen innebär variation och mycket kontakt med både utrustning och kollegor.

Vem tror vi att du är?

Vi tror att du kan ha många olika vägar in i rollen.

Kanske har du arbetat som industrimekaniker, underhållstekniker, servicetekniker, CNC-tekniker, maskinoperatör eller produktionstekniker. Kanske har du en teknisk utbildning och har upptäckt att det är när du får arbeta praktiskt som du trivs som bäst. Det vi framför allt letar efter är en person som:

    

Är praktiskt lagd och tycker om att arbeta med händerna

    

Har ett genuint tekniskt intresse

    

Gillar att felsöka och lösa problem

    

Har grundläggande kunskaper inom mekanik

    

Har erfarenhet av industri, produktion, service eller underhåll

    

Är bekväm med att använda verktyg och teknisk utrustning

    

Kan läsa och förstå tekniska instruktioner och enklare ritningar

    

Har grundläggande datorvana

    

Behärskar svenska och engelska

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet från optikbranschen. Har du arbetat med CNC, finmekanik, precisionsmaskiner, medicinteknik eller annan tekniskt avancerad produktion är det ett stort plus, men det är din tekniska förståelse och vilja att lära som väger tyngst.

Vi erbjuder dig

    

Ett spännande uppdrag hos ett innovativt teknikföretag

    

Möjlighet att arbeta med avancerad optik- och sensorteknik

    

En modern arbetsmiljö med hög teknisk kompetens

    

Möjlighet att utvecklas inom underhåll och maskinteknik

    

Goda möjligheter till ett långsiktigt uppdrag för rätt person

jobs.title: Supervisor Pipe Installation
jobs.description:
I VARD utvikler vi innovative og bærekraftige løsninger for den globale maritime industrien. Gjennom sterk ingeniørkompetanse, banebrytende teknologi og tett samarbeid designer og bygger vi noen av verdens mest avanserte fartøy. 

Samtidig mener vi at menneskene våre er vår viktigste styrke. Vi legger til rette for et inkluderende og støttende arbeidsmiljø der talenter får utvikle seg, ideer blir verdsatt, og den enkelte får mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell. 

Vard Søviknes er et av VARDs tre norske verft.  Verftet spesialiserer seg på utrustning, ferdigstillelse og levering av avanserte spesialfartøy. Med moderne fasiliteter, høy fagkompetanse og et sterkt fokus på kvalitet og sikkerhet bidrar verftet til å realisere noen av de mest innovative fartøyprosjektene i den globale maritime industrien. Som en del av VARD-konsernet samarbeider vi tett med våre design- og produksjonsmiljøer for å utvikle fremtidens maritime løsninger. 

Vi søker nå etter en Supervisor Pipe Installation som vil være med på laget vårt. I denne rollen får du muligheten til å bruke kompetansen din, samarbeide med dyktige kollegaer og bidra til spennende prosjekter på tvers av VARDs verdikjede.

Er du klar til å gjøre en forskjell i VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Lede og følge opp installasjon av rørsystemer samt aktiviteter knyttet til pre-commissioning og commissioning
  • Overvåke daglig fremdrift, bemanningsytelse og nøkkelindikatorer (KPI-er) for installasjonsarbeidet
  • Koordinere arbeidet med andre fagområder (HVAC/ventilasjon, innredning og skrog) for å sikre riktig arbeidsrekkefølge og unngå produksjonskonflikter
  • Sikre korrekt gjennomføring av trykktesting, flushing/rensing, dokumentasjon og klargjøring av systemer for commissioning
  • Følge opp materialforbruk, forbruksmateriell og lagerbeholdning
  • Utbedre funn i forbindelse med inspeksjoner og gjennomgang av teknisk dokumentasjon
  • Rapportere avvik, tekniske utfordringer og endringer som kan påvirke tidsplan eller kostnader
Qualifications
  • Fagbrev innen relevant fagområde
  • Relevant erfaring fra skipsbygging, maritim industri eller lignende virksomhet
  • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Erfaring med rørinstallasjoner og rørsystem fra skip/ verft
  • Annen relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formalkunnskap

VARD jobber systematisk for inkludering og mangfold og oppfordrer alle til å søke, selv om din kompetanse ikke samsvarer 100% med det ovenfor.  

Denne ansettelsen kan kreve bakgrunnssjekk eller sikkerhetsklarering fra Nasjonal sikkerhetsmyndighet.

Personal qualities
  • Ansvarsbevisst og målrettet
  • Gode samarbeidsevner
  • Kvalitetsbevist og yrkesstolthet
  • Identifiserer deg med VARDs verdier: Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship
Hvorfor jobbe i VARD?

Hos VARD blir du en del av et internasjonalt selskap der innovasjon, samarbeid og kontinuerlig utvikling er en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen. Vi er opptatt av å skape et arbeidsmiljø der mennesker trives, utvikler seg og lykkes sammen.

Som en del av teamet vårt får du blant annet:

  • Spennende og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver i et globalt maritimt miljø
  • Gode muligheter for læring, faglig utvikling og karrieremuligheter
  • En konkurransedyktig pensjonsordning og gode forsikringsordninger
  • Fleksibel arbeidstidsordning
  • Subsidiert lunsj i kantinen
  • Subsidiert treningsmedlemskap som bidrar til god helse og trivsel
  • Bedriftshelsetjeneste
  • Gratis parkering

Hos VARD vet vi også at en god arbeidsplass handler om mer enn bare jobb. Gjennom Social by VARD får du muligheten til å bli kjent med kolleger på tvers av team og lokasjoner gjennom et bredt spekter av sosiale aktiviteter og arrangementer. Enten det er fjordcruise, fjellturer, matlagingskurs, fotballtrening, gokart eller vinsmaking, finnes det mange muligheter til å bygge relasjoner, dele opplevelser og skape minner sammen.

Med den rette miksen av å ha det gøy, ekspertise og hardt arbeid skaper vi morgendagens skip. Bli med!

World leaders in offering the best marine engineering solutions, we are the only shipbuilders who can conceive, design and construct all types of extremely complex ships, from cruise vessels to mega yachts, naval vessels and high-tech offshore units. Every ship is a unique, state-of-the-art, highly complex and innovative product, a symbol of our culture and the result of the excellence of sound engineering expertise. We are proud of our active participation in all the segments with the most potential, and although our roots are in Italy, we are present around the globe with sites and infrastructure on four continents. jobs.title: Restaurantchef til Henrik Jyrks nye eventyr
jobs.description:
I November åbner Norrlyst Koncernen dørene til Tamashii - et nyt ambitiøst restaurantprojekt på en af Københavns mest unikke lokationer

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Fra køkken og service til vinkort og indretning er Tamashii skabt med en ambition om at nå Michelin-niveau.

Nu søger vi en restaurantchef, der vil være med til at sætte retningen for hele gæsteoplevelsen og stå i spidsen for et hold, hvor service, struktur og nærvær er afgørende.

Om Norrlyst Koncernen

Norrlyst Koncernen står bag nogle af Københavns mest markante restauranter og vinbarer. Fælles for vores steder er en kompromisløs tilgang til kvalitet, stærkt værtskab og et ønske om konstant at udvikle os.

Vi tror på, at de bedste restauranter skabes af mennesker, der tager ansvar, skaber relationer og løfter hinanden. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med ledelse, kultur og udvikling – og vi giver plads til dem, der vil sætte deres præg.

Som restaurantchef bliver du en nøgleperson i åbningen og får ansvaret for at skabe rammerne for en serviceoplevelse, der er lige så gennemtænkt som gastronomien.

Rollen

Du bliver den daglige leder af restauranten og får det overordnede ansvar for service, værtskab og drift i front of house.

Du skal sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen hænger sammen fra første kontakt til sidste farvel – og at teamet arbejder som én enhed, hvor struktur, overblik og energi går hånd i hånd.

Du er tæt på driften, men også på kulturen. Du er synlig på gulvet, sætter retning for dit team og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor faglighed og arbejdsglæde går hånd i hånd.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring som restaurantchef, maître d’, assisterende restaurantchef eller lignende lederrolle i en ambitiøs restaurant.

  • Er en stærk leder, der kan skabe ro, struktur og energi i service.

  • Har et naturligt værtskab og brænder for at skabe gode gæsteoplevelser.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har styr på både drift, planlægning og personaleledelse.

  • Trives med ansvar og motiveres af at bygge et team og en kultur op fra bunden.

  • Er tydelig, nærværende og god til at få mennesker til at lykkes sammen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i åbningen af et nyt og ambitiøst restaurantprojekt.

  • Stor indflydelse på opbygningen af service, struktur og team.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med køkkenchef og ledelse om at skabe en samlet gæsteoplevelse.

  • Muligheden for at præge kulturen fra første dag.

  • Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Personalefordele på tværs af Norrlyst Koncernens restauranter og vinbarer.

Hvis du motiveres af værtskab, ledelse og ambitionen om at skabe en restaurantoplevelse på højt niveau, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare till Familjehemsenheten
jobs.description:
Uddevalla – en plats för hela livet

Välkommen att bli en del av vår växande kommun - och att tillsammans med oss arbeta för att ge våra kommuninvånare ännu bättre service. 

Vi erbjuder en attraktiv arbetsplats som ger dig stora möjligheter att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vårt mål är att alla ska kunna trivas och växa - under ett helt yrkesliv. Vi vill också utvecklas som arbetsgivare och arbetar aktivt för att på bästa sätt ta till vara på din kunskap och ditt engagemang. Vi uppskattar och uppmuntrar till medskapande från alla.

Uddevalla kommun är en vacker plats vid havet i hjärtat av Bohuslän. Vi tror på ett öppet och positivt samspel mellan kommun, utbildning, näringsliv och kultur. 

Vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas hos oss!

Om arbetsplatsen

Vill du göra skillnad för barn – varje dag? Bli vår nya barnsekreterare!

Vi söker nu en barnsekreterare som vill bli en del av vår fina arbetsgrupp på Familjehemsenheten. Här får du ett meningsfullt, omväxlande och utvecklande arbete tillsammans med engagerade kollegor som stöttar varandra och har nära till skratt.

Om rollen

Som barnsekreterare följer du upp barn som är placerade i familjehem. Du arbetar nära våra familjehemssekreterare och tillsammans bildar ni ett tryggt team runt barnet och dess nätverk.

Ditt uppdrag är att planera och arbeta för att varje barn ska få en gynnsam situation, trygghet och god utveckling, i samarbete med viktiga personer runt barnet.

Du blir en del av en erfaren arbetsgrupp som består av åtta socialsekreterare som ansvarar för de placerade barnen, nio familjehemssekreterare som rekryterar och handleder familjehemmen, en socialadministratör, tre första socialsekreterare samt en enhetschef.

Tillsammans utgör vi en arbetsplats med både kompetens, värme och en stark gemenskap. Här får du ett arbete där du verkligen gör skillnad, i en grupp som stöttar och lyfter varandra och där du ges variation, ansvar och goda möjligheter att växa i din yrkesroll.

Arbetsuppgifter

Dina primära arbetsuppgifter är att följa upp familjehemsvården för de placerade barnen i nära samverkan med familjehemssekreterarna.

    Handläggning och dokumentation utifrån gällande lagstiftning.
    Samverka med familjehemssekreterarna och andra professionella parter.
    Ha kontakt med barnens vårdnadshavare, familjehem och övriga nätverk.
    Förmåga att skapa relation till barnen och andra viktiga personer i nätverket.

Arbetet innebär en stor del dokumentation och därför behöver du tycka om att skriva och ha en god förmåga att uttrycka dig i skrift.

Som barnsekreterare hos oss får du en bra introduktion, metod- och processhandledning i en arbetsgrupp med stor erfarenhet. Vi erbjuder en professionell och inkluderande familjehemsvård som alltid strävar efter att ge barnen bästa möjliga förutsättningar till en god uppväxt. Förutom detta erbjuds du flextidsavtal, friskvårdstimma, friskvårdsbidrag samt förtroendtid om tre timmar/månad.

Vem söker vi

Vi är en arbetsgrupp som har ett nära samarbete, trivs med varandra och har roligt ihop. Vi stöttar varandra även i perioder där arbetet är utmanande.  

Vi söker dig som:

    Tycker om att samarbeta och har initiativförmåga vilket du visar genom att bygga positiva relationer med barnen/föräldrar och kollegor.
    Kan möta barn och föräldrar i svåra situationer, vilket kräver att du är trygg, lugn och stabil i din yrkesroll.
    Kan planera, organisera och prioritera dina arbetsuppgifter på ett effektivt sätt.
    Har en god kommunikativ förmåga och arbetar med barnets bästa i fokus.

Kvalifikationer

    Du är socionom eller har annan högskoleutbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
     B-körkort är ett krav

Det är meriterande om du har arbetat som socialsekreterare inom området barn- och unga eller annat arbete kopplat till myndighetsutövning inom Socialtjänsten. Det är även meriterande om du har erfarenhet av BBIC och verksamhetssystemet Lifecare.

Övrigt

jobs.title: Maskinoperatör inom optik - FLIR!
jobs.description:
Är du en noggrann maskinoperatör som gillar teknik, precision och att se ett riktigt bra resultat av ditt arbete? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!

WeStaff Sweden söker nu en noggrann och tekniskt intresserad maskinoperatör till FLIR i Täby. Här får du arbeta i en avancerad produktionsmiljö där precision är en självklar del av vardagen och där det du tillverkar används i produkter med höga krav på kvalitet.

Det här passar dig som har erfarenhet av CNC, slipning, precisionsbearbetning eller maskinoperatörsarbete och som vill utvecklas vidare inom ett tekniskt specialistområde.

Om rollen

Som maskinoperatör blir du en viktig del av produktionen och arbetar med bearbetning av optiska komponenter.

Du kommer att arbeta nära maskinerna och följa produkten genom olika steg i tillverkningsprocessen. En stor del av arbetet handlar om att säkerställa att maskinerna är rätt inställda och att varje komponent håller den kvalitet och precision som krävs.

Det är ett arbete där noggrannhet, tålamod och tekniskt handlag gör stor skillnad.

I tjänsten kommer du bland annat:

    

Ställa in och köra CNC-styrda produktionsmaskiner

    

Förbereda material, verktyg och fixturer inför produktion

    

Göra enklare justeringar av maskinens inställningar

    

Övervaka processen och säkerställa att produktionen går enligt plan

    

Kontrollera detaljer under och efter bearbetning

    

Mäta komponenter och kontrollera att de håller rätt mått och toleranser

    

Arbeta utifrån ritningar, instruktioner och specifikationer

    

Dokumentera utförda kontroller och resultat

    

Hantera verktyg och förbrukningsmaterial

    

Uppmärksamma avvikelser och bidra till att lösa problem

    

Utföra enklare dagligt underhåll och skötsel av utrustningen

Arbetet innebär även hantering av optiska komponenter där varsamhet och precision är viktigt.

En roll för dig som gillar att få det rätt

Det här är inte en roll där det räcker att trycka på en knapp och gå vidare.

Du behöver vara intresserad av hur maskinen, verktygen och materialet samspelar och förstå att små justeringar kan påverka slutresultatet.

Du kommer att arbeta med komponenter där mått, geometri och ytkvalitet behöver hålla mycket hög nivå. Därför söker vi dig som uppskattar ett arbete där man får använda både händerna och huvudet.

Din bakgrund

Vi är öppna för flera olika bakgrunder. Du kan exempelvis ha arbetat som:

    

CNC-operatör

    

CNC-ställare

    

Maskinoperatör

    

Produktionsoperatör

    

Slipoperatör

    

Maskintekniker

    

Operatör inom finmekanik eller precisionsbearbetning

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av optik för att vara aktuell. Har du arbetat med CNC, slipning, svarvning, fräsning eller annan precisionsbearbetning och är van vid att arbeta med ritningar, mätning och toleranser har du en bra grund för rollen.

Vi ser gärna att du har

    

Praktisk erfarenhet av maskin- eller produktionsarbete

    

Erfarenhet av CNC eller annan styrd produktionsutrustning

    

Vana av att läsa ritningar och förstå toleranser

    

Erfarenhet av mätning och kvalitetskontroller

    

Ett genuint tekniskt intresse

    

God datorvana

    

God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Erfarenhet av optisk bearbetning eller precisionsslipning är meriterande, men inget krav.

Vem tror vi att du är?

Du är förmodligen den person som hellre gör en sak ordentligt än snabbt. Du gillar när det finns en tydlig process, men kan också själv se när något inte fungerar som det ska. Du är noggrann utan att fastna, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och har lätt för att lära dig nya maskiner och arbetsmetoder.

Om FLIR

FLIR, en del av Teledyne Technologies, utvecklar avancerad teknik inom bland annat värmekameror, optik och sensorsystem. Här blir du en del av en tekniskt avancerad produktionsmiljö där precision och kvalitet står i fokus.

För dig som trivs med teknik och noggrant produktionsarbete finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom ett område där detaljerna verkligen gör skillnad.

Tjänsten är förlagd till 2-skift:

    

Förmiddag: Måndag–torsdag 06:00–14:09, fredag 06:00–12:09

    

Eftermiddag: Måndag–torsdag 13:51–22:00, fredag 11:51–18:00

Praktisk information

    

Omfattning: Heltid, långsiktigt

    

Arbetstid: 2-skift

    

Start: Omgående eller enligt överenskommelse

    

Plats: Arninge/Täby

    

Anställning: Konsultanställning via WeStaff Sweden med goda möjligheter till ett långsiktigt uppdrag och på sikt möjlighet till anställning hos FLIR

Din nya arbetsgivare

WeStaff Sweden AB är ett växande konsult- och rekryteringsföretag inom Produktion & Tillverkning. Våra värderingar bygger på personlig relation, trygghet och långsiktighet.

Vi är ett kunskapsdrivet team med över 30 års samlad erfarenhet från branschen. Vårt arbete kännetecknas av kvalitet, nytänkande och ett personligt engagemang. Läs mer om oss på www.westaff.se

Vill du bli en del av oss? Ansök redan idag och bli vår nästa medarbetare!

jobs.title: Business Controller, Vianor
jobs.description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for business audiences.
- High level of integrity, ownership and attention to detail, combined with the ability to operate independently and drive improvement across processes, tools and ways of working.
- Good command of modern finance systems, reporting tools and data analytics solutions; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.
- Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English. Other relevant languages are considered an advantage.

The successful candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial curiosity and a hands-on understanding of business operations. They are expected to be proactive, structured and collaborative, with the confidence to challenge the business constructively while building trust-based relationships across functions and countries.

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters, and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.

Are you interested in joining our inspiring team?

Please send the application, including your CV and salary request by 11th October 2026.

For further information, please contact: Timo Koponen,e-mail timo.koponen@nokiantyres.com.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen. 

I over 200 år har OsloMet – storbyuniversitetet bidratt til å bygge kunnskap og kompetanse for det norske velferdssamfunnet. I dag er OsloMet et moderne og urbant universitet som er kjent for sine store og solide fagmiljøer innenfor lærerutdanning, helse- og sosialfag, samfunnsforskning, design og teknologifag.

jobs.title: Construction carpenter
jobs.description:
We are looking for 10 experienced Carpenters to join construction projects in Haugesund.

Adecco is one of Norway's leading companies within staffing and recruitment. Every day, we successfully match qualified candidates with a wide range of positions and projects.

As a Carpenter with Adecco, you will work on construction projects for our clients, carrying out a variety of tasks both indoors and outdoors. This is a good opportunity for experienced Carpenters looking for a stable project in Norway.

As a Carpenter, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Carrying out carpentry work on construction projects

  • Working both indoors and outdoors

  • Installation of structural and finishing elements

  • Carrying out assigned tasks according to project requirements and documentation

  • Ensuring high quality and accuracy in your work

  • Following HSE and safety regulations

  • Cooperating with other members of the team

This is an assignment with ASAP start, working on a 6/2 rotation.

Qualifications:

  • Relevant experience as a Carpenter

  • Previous experience with carpentry work on construction projects

  • Experience with both interior and exterior work

  • Required language skills for effective workplace communication

  • Driving licence required

  • Willingness to work on a 6/2 rotation

  • Availability to start ASAP

  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team

About you

We are looking for experienced construction professionals who know their trade and are confident working independently. You are reliable, accurate and committed to delivering high-quality work.

Good organisation, teamwork and a strong focus on safety are also important in this role.

You are offered

We offer competitive employment conditions, flexibility and support throughout your assignment. Working with Adecco gives you the opportunity to gain experience on Norwegian construction projects and develop your professional skills.

  • Attractive and competitive salary

  • Approximately 48 hours per week

  • 6/2 rotation

  • Accommodation: 4,600 NOK per month

  • Single room

  • First travel to Norway covered up to 1,500 NOK

  • ASAP start

  • Location: Haugesund

  • Possibility of long-term cooperation

  • Salary paid every 14 days

  • Access to Adecco's benefits programme

  • Training provided by the client

  • Continuous support from an Adecco consultant

Contact information

If you have any questions about the position or recruitment process, please contact the responsible recruiter:

Natalia Janeczek – Adecco
📞 +48 726 008 495
📧 natalia.janeczek@adecco.no

For questions regarding registration, please contact info@adecco.no.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Adecco er et av Norges ledende rekrutterings- og bemanningsselskap. Hvert år hjelper vi hundrevis av mennesker til å finne en ny jobb. På kundelisten har vi attraktive bedrifter som trenger kompetente kandidater til spennende oppdrag. Siden oppstarten av selskapet 1948 (Norsk Kontaktservice) har Adecco ansatt hundretusenvis av mennesker i en rekke forskjellige bransjer i hele Norge.

Med over 35 kontorer fra Hammerfest i nord til Kristiansand i sør kan du føle deg trygg på at vi har god kunnskap om ditt lokale marked.

jobs.title: Køkkenmedhjælper søges til efterskole i Vinderup
jobs.description:
På vegne af en efterskole i Vinderup søger FIRMAVIKAR en stabil og arbejdsom køkkenmedhjælper til et kortere vikariat mandag, tirsdag og onsdag i næste uge.

Du bliver en del af skolens køkken og hjælper med de daglige opgaver i forbindelse med tilberedning, anretning og oprydning. Vi søger en person, som trives i et køkkenmiljø og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Dine opgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Hjælp til klargøring og tilberedning af mad

  • Anretning og opfyldning

  • Opvask og oprydning

  • Rengøring i køkkenet

  • Andre praktiske køkkenopgaver efter behov

Vi søger dig, som

  • Gerne har erfaring fra køkken, kantine, café eller lignende

  • Er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Arbejder effektivt og kan tage initiativ

  • Trives i et travlt miljø

  • Har en positiv tilgang til arbejdet og samarbejdet med andre

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Efterskole i Vinderup, Holstebro Kommune
Periode: Mandag, tirsdag og onsdag i næste uge
Arbejdstid: Kl. 07.00–14.00

Stillingen passer godt til dig, der gerne vil have nogle ekstra vagter og har erfaring med praktiske opgaver i et køkken.

Er du interesseret, så send os gerne en kort besked med dit navn, din erfaring og om du kan arbejde alle tre dage.

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

As AI becomes embedded in everyday work, employees increasingly interact with AI agents, but also encounter AI-mediated contributions from colleagues. Messages may be written, filtered or delivered with AI, while autonomous agents increasingly participate in work processes and collaboration.

This doctoral project examines how these developments shape relational aspects of work, (which may include authenticity, trust, social connection, and experiences of loneliness), as people negotiate emerging norms around AI use, disclosure, and appropriate forms of interaction. Through ethnographic research in AI-intensive settings, you will follow relational practices as they evolve over time and identify the mechanisms behind change.

The project will develop evidence-based guidance that supports transparency, social connection and responsible AI use in organisational life. Practitioner outputs include AI- aware communication norms, guidance on disclosure and authenticity in AI-assisted exchanges, and leadership practices that protect social connection and prevent relational deterioration. In addition, the doctoral project is expected to advance scientific knowledge in relation to the doctoral topic.

Your work

- Examine how interactions among people, AI agents and AI-mediated communication shape workplace relationships and collaboration.
- Conduct ethnographic research on how employees make sense of and negotiate AI use in workplace interactions, including norms of disclosure and transparency, and how these processes shape relational aspects of work.
- Identify the mechanisms through which AI-mediated contributions and autonomous agents reshape relational dynamics, and develop evidence-based guidance for responsible and socially sustainable AI use.
- Develop AI-aware communication norms and leadership guidance that protect social connection at work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Emma Nordbäck (emma.nordback@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Associate Professor Emma Nordbäck (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. jobs.title: Telineasentaja, rakennustelineet ja sääsuojarakenteet (Helsinki)
jobs.description:
Kiinteistöjen rakennus- ja saneeraustöiden tekeminen laadukkaasti sekä turvallisesti edellyttää tarkoituksenmukaisia teline- ja sääsuojaratkaisuja. Erikoistuminen ja tasokas ammattiosaaminen pitää yrityksen tilauskannan positiivisena seesteisinäkin aikoina ja ympäri vuoden sekä luo kasvupotentiaalia. Etsimmekin nyt telineasentajaa alalla jo vuosikymmeniä toimineen asiakasyrityksemme tehtäviin pääkaupunkiseudulle pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työt koostuvat rakennustelineiden ja sääsuojarakenteiden / sääsuojien asennus- ja purkutehtävistä. Työt tehdään ryhmässä tai asentajaparin kanssa. Työkohteet sijaitsevat pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä ympäristökunnissa ja niihin tyypillisesti kuljetaan omalla autolla. Työntekijälle maksetaan TES:n mukainen korvaus päivittäisistä matkakustannuksista kotoa työkohteeseen sekä km-korvaus mahdollisista työkohteiden välisistä ajoista. Tekijän asuinpaikasta riippuen useimpiin työkohteisiin pääsee joustavasti myös julkisilla liikennevälineillä.

Työ on arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä klo 7:00 - 15:30, pääasiassa 40 h/vko. Työpäivien pituudessa voi esiintyä jonkin verran vaihtelua. Tehtävässä noudatetaan rakennusalan työehtosopimusta. Palkkaus kokemuksen ja sopimuksen mukaisesti.

Arvostamme hakijassa luonnollisesti kokemusta vastaavista asennustöistä, sillä telineiden ja konsoleiden asennus lujasti ja turvallisesti on ensisijaisen tärkeätä. Otamme haussa huomioon myös alaa kokemattomat tehtävään soveltuvat hakijat. Työssä menestymiseen siivittää halu sekä kyky aktiiviseen ja fyysiseen tekemiseen sekä vastuullinen työote. Oleellista on säilyttää toimintakyky korkeammallakin työskennellessä. Tehtävään annetaan asianmukainen perehdytys ja kollegoiden tuki sekä työhön kuuluvat varusteet.

Tehtävässä voidaan aloittaa pikaisestikin sopivan henkilön löydyttyä kauttamme määräaikaisella vuokratyösuhteella, jonka päätteeksi tekijän on tarkoitus jatkaa vakituisessa työsuhteessa asiakasyrityksessämme pitkäaikaisesti.

Tässä on toimeliaalle tekijälle hyvä työ hyvin hoidetussa ja työntekijöistään välittävässä yrityksessä. Tarjoamme työvaatetuksen, perustasoa kattavammat työterveyspalvelut sekä Clickin oman yhteyshenkilön vahvan tuen.

Haastatteluja tehdään jo hakuaikana, joten täytähän pikaisesti hakemus oheisen linkin kautta. Voit laittaa hakemuksen ja ansioluettelosi myös sähköpostilla. Kerro hakemuksessa mahdollisimman tarkasti osaamisestasi ja aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointia hoitava rekrytointikonsultti Jan Kollin puhelimitse arkisin klo 9.00-16.00. Puh. 050 411 0390 ja sähköposti on muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi

jobs.title: Rengøringsmedarbejdere søges til fuldtidsstillinger
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder søger vi stabile og ansvarsbevidste rengøringsmedarbejdere til faste fuldtidsstillinger.

Du kommer til at arbejde med rengøring hos private kunder på forskellige adresser i hovedstadsområdet, Nordsjælland og ned mod Roskilde.

Der stilles firmabil til rådighed, som du kan køre hjem i og benytte direkte ud til dagens kunder. Du skal derfor som udgangspunkt ikke møde ind på virksomhedens adresse i Nivå hver dag.

Du vil kun skulle forbi adressen i Nivå en gang imellem, eksempelvis for at hente rene klude, rengøringsprodukter og øvrigt udstyr.

Dagens rute planlægges så vidt muligt med udgangspunkt i din bopæl.

Arbejdsopgaver

Arbejdet består af almindelig rengøring i private hjem, herunder:

  • Støvsugning og gulvvask

  • Afstøvning

  • Rengøring og afkalkning af køkken og badeværelse

  • Fjernelse af spindelvæv

  • Øvrige almindelige rengøringsopgaver

Erfaring med rengøring er en fordel, men ikke et krav, da du får den nødvendige oplæring.

Arbejdstid

Du skal kunne stå til rådighed mandag til fredag mellem kl. 08.00 og 16.00.

Du er garanteret minimum 32 timer om ugen, og der vil typisk være mulighed for flere timer. Stillingen betragtes derfor som fuldtid.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har gyldigt kørekort – dette er et krav

  • Er stabil og møder til tiden

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver

  • Er serviceminded og respektfuld, da arbejdet foregår i private hjem

  • Har sans for kvalitet og grundighed

  • Gerne har erfaring med rengøring, men det er ikke et krav

Praktisk information

Område: Hovedstadsområdet, Nordsjælland og ned mod Roskilde

Arbejdstid: Mandag–fredag mellem kl. 08.00–16.00

Timer: Minimum 32 timer om ugen, typisk flere

Firmabil: Ja – bilen kan køres med hjem og bruges direkte ud til kunderne

Mødested: Du skal ikke møde i Nivå hver dag. Der vil kun være behov for at komme forbi virksomheden lejlighedsvis for at hente klude, produkter og andet udstyr.

Ansættelse: Timelønnet hos vores kunde

Opstart: Efter nærmere aftale

Du får adgang til virksomhedens system, hvor du kan se dagens kunder, adresser og tider samt registrere start og afslutning på opgaverne.

Ansøgning

Er du interesseret i stillingen, så send os dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af dig selv.

jobs.description:
Etsimme lähihoitajaa sijaisuuteen ajalle 1.10.2026 - 31.1.2027

Tehtäväsi

Tule vahvistamaan Katajakodin arkea. Katajakoti on 60-paikkainen ympärivuorokautisen palveluasumisen yksikkö Someron Lamminniemen luonnonkauniilla alueella.

Lähihoitajana työskentelet osana moniammatillista tiimiä suunnitellen, toteuttaen ja arvioiden asukkaiden hoitoa annettujen määräysten mukaisesti. Työhösi kuuluu perushoitoa, lääkehoitoa sekä kulttuuri- ja harrastetoiminnan toteuttamista. Tuet asukkaiden osallisuutta ja toimintakykyä kuntouttavalla työotteella sekä toimit työvuoron vastuuhoitajana suunnitelman mukaisesti.

Tehtävässä teet tiivistä yhteistyötä omaisten ja eri sidosryhmien kanssa. Vastaat omalta osaltasi kirjaamisesta, tiedottamisesta ja raportoinnista sekä osallistut yksikön toiminnan kehittämiseen. Lisäksi ylläpidät omaa ammattitaitoasi, ohjaat opiskelijoita ja osallistut uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämiseen.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Saat työyhteisön, jossa tekemistäsi arvostetaan ja jossa pääset työskentelemään merkityksellisen työn parissa ikääntyneiden hyväksi.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi sisäisten koulutusten avulla. Pääset vahvistamaan ammattitaitoasi, osallistumaan toiminnan kehittämiseen ja työskentelemään ympäristössä, jossa jokaisen panoksella on merkitystä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toimit luontevasti erilaisten ihmisten kanssa, sillä työ sisältää paljon yhteistyötä työtovereiden, omaisten ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa. Sinulla on hyvä suomen kielen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta ikääntyneiden palveluista, halua kehittää työtä ja yksikön toimintaa sekä myönteistä suhtautumista opiskelijayhteistyöhön ja opiskelijoiden ohjaamiseen. Eduksi katsomme hygieniapassin, voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan, RAI-arviointimittariston tuntemuksen sekä hyvät tietotekniset taidot.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon ammatillinen perustutkinto (lähihoitaja) tai alan aikaisempi kouluasteinen tutkinto sekä voimassa oleva rekisteröinti JulkiTerhikki- ja JulkiSuosikki-rekisterissä.

jobs.title: Master Thesis: Reimagining Outdoor Experiences for Diverse Audiences
jobs.description:
Dometic is a global market leader in the mobile living industry. Millions of people around the world use Dometic products in outdoor, residential, and professional applications. We are on a growth journey – now looking for our next star – a passionate Master's Thesis student with a strong interest in human-centered design, user research, and innovation. Exploring new opportunities and transforming insights into impactful product experiences. You bring creativity, analytical thinking, and a drive to tackle complex challenges.

About the position

As a Master’s thesis student collaborating across Group Sustainability, Global Design, and Global Marketing, you will investigate how product design, consumer insights, brand positioning, and strategic partnerships can make outdoor products and experiences more accessible, relevant, inclusive, and desirable.

Women will serve as the primary research focus and starting point for uncovering overlooked needs and barriers. The ambition is not to design exclusively for women, but to translate these insights into inclusive solutions with broader market relevance. Building on recent Design for Inclusion research, consumer insights, and market segmentation, you will turn research findings into actionable recommendations for future product concepts, experiences, marketing strategies, and collaboration opportunities.

    Duration: Planned for 6 months (Spring Semester)
    Team: Open to 1 or 2 students working together

Your main responsibilities

    Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research with diverse user groups, with a particular focus on women, to understand needs, preferences, experiences, and barriers to outdoor participation. 
    Evaluate current outdoor gear and translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product design, accessibility, and user experience. 
    Develop messaging and brand recommendations that help make outdoor experiences more relevant and welcoming to a broader audience. 
    Benchmark how leading brands address inclusiveness and collaborate with Dometic specialists across sustainability, design, marketing, and inclusive design to identify future product, partnership, and innovation opportunities.

What do we offer?

You will join a dynamic, fast-paced global environment with access to real-world data, consumer insights, and industry specialists across Group Sustainability, Global Design, and Global Marketing. Primary mentorship will be provided by our Senior Industrial Designer who is part of the Global Design team.

This multidisciplinary setup offers a complete 360-degree view of how a global company transforms user insights into tangible product and brand innovations. Your research will directly inform and influence Dometic’s future product roadmap.

Suitable Background

We are looking for candidates with a solid foundation in user research, product design, or innovation management, along with:

    Industrial Engineering and Management, Industrial Economics and Management, Technology and Innovation Management, or Technology-based Entrepreneurship.
    Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, preferably with a focus on design engineering, product development, or product management.
    Industrial Design with focus on user experience, consumer research, or another relevant discipline.
    Academic or practical experience in qualitative user research, such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, or structured feedback analysis, with the ability to translate findings into actionable recommendations.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies & characteristics:

    A genuine interest in the outdoors and hands-on experience with camping-related products, together with a strong drive to make outdoor activities more enjoyable and welcoming for everyone.
    A basic understanding of inclusive design and how products and experiences can be made more accessible.
    The ability to build trust with diverse or underrepresented user groups and uncover genuine, sometimes unstated, needs.
    Curiosity, analytical thinking, strong communication and collaboration skills, and the drive to take ownership of the research scope and navigate ambiguity.

Dometic's Core Values

To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

Dometic is a global outdoor technology company dedicated to making mobile living easy. Leveraging our core expertise in cooling, heating, power and electronics, mobility and space optimization, we enable more people to connect with nature and enjoy a greater sense of freedom outdoors. We do this by designing smart, sustainable and reliable products with outstanding design. Millions of people worldwide use our solutions while camping or exploring nature in RVs, boats and cars. Our portfolio includes installed products for land vehicles and boats, as well as standalone solutions for outdoor enthusiasts.

We employ approximately 7,000 people globally and sell our products in more than 100 countries. In 2025, we reported net sales of SEK 21 billion (USD 2.3 billion) and are headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

jobs.title: CNC laserleikkaaja/ CNC laser cutter
jobs.description:
CNC-laserleikkaaja

Etsimme taitavaa CNC-laserleikkaajaa pitkät perinteet omaavalle laitilalaliselle konepajalle. Olisitko sinä sopiva vahvistus kansainväliseen tiimiin, jossa arvostetaan ammattitaitoa, monipuolisuutta ja halua kehittyä työssäsi?

Tehtävässä menestyäksesi osaat tulkita piirustuksia joiden pohjalta tuotat useita pieniä sarjoja työvuoron aikana, olet motivoitunut ja monipuolinen ammattilainen, joka viihtyy haastavissakin työtehtävissä. Työ on kaksivuorotyötä.

Tehtävät:

- Koneen asetukset ja käyttö:
- CNC-laserkoneiden asetukset ja kalibrointi työn vaatimusten ja piirustusten mukaisesti (kuitulaser)

- Materiaalien, kuten mustan teräksen, ruostumattoman teräksen ja alumiinin (0,5–20 mm paksuus) kiinnitykset koneeseen, varmistaen oikea kohdistus ja turvallisuus.

- Tuotannossa pieniä sarjakokoja, joten mahdollisesti useiden erilaisten kappaleiden ohjelmointi vuoron aikana.


- Ohjelmointi ja kokoonpano:
- Ohjelmointi CNC-laserkoneen ohjelmistolla tai parametrien syöttö manuaalisesti piirustusten perusteella.

- Ohjelman käydessä tarpeellisten muokkausten ja säätöjen teko optimaalisen suorituskyvyn ja laadun varmistamiseksi.


- Laadunvalvonta:
- Tarkastat ja mittaat tuotannon aikana valmiita osia varmistaaksesi, että ne vastaavat piirustuksia ja täyttävät laatuvaatimukset

- Ohjelman käydessä tunnistat ja korjaat pokkeamat ja tee tarvittavat säädöt


- Seuranta ja vianmääritys:
- Prosessin tarkkailu ja tarvittaessa ohjelman korjaus


- Turvallisuusprotokollat:
- Noudatat kaikkia turvallisuusmääräyksiä turvallisen työympäristön ylläpitämiseksi.


- Yhteistyö ja viestintä:
- Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tiiminvetäjän tai esihenkilön kanssa sujuvan työnkulun ja jatkuvan parantamisen varmistamiseksi.


Mitä odotamme sinulta:

- vahvoja organisointitaitoja, kykyä optimoida koneen käyttö ja tehostaa työprosesseja

- huolellisuutta ja tarkkaa silmää yksityiskohdille

- kykyä ohjelmoida ja käyttää CNC-ohjattuja kuitulasereita, mukaan lukien säätö ja tarvittavat muutokset.

- kykyä lukea ja tulkita teknisiä piirustuksia.

- taito käyttää erilaisia mittausvälineitä laadun varmistamiseksi

- valmiutta työskennellä kaksivuorotyössä

- CAD-osaamista

- Sujuvaa suomen tai englannin kielen taitoa.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tehtävä on kokoaikainen (ma-pe) ja vakituinen vuokratyösuhde Talent Centerin kanssa. Työ on kaksivuorotyötä, jossa palkkaus ja työehdot määräytyvät teknologiateollisuuden työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi tämän ilmoituksen kautta mahdollisimman pian, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään 31.10.2026. Hakuprosessi etenee ripeästi ja käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Johanna Mäkelä, johanna.makela@talentcenter.fi arkisin 8-16 välillä.

___________________________________________________________________________________________________________

CNC laser cutter operator

We are seeking a skilled CNC Laser cutter operator for our client, a long-established engineering workshop in Laitila. Would you be a good addition for our international team, where we value professionalism, versatility, and a desire to grow in your work?

To succeed in this role, you will be able to interpret technical drawings and use them to program several small series during your shift. You are a motivated and versatile professional who thrives in challenging work environments. The work is in two shifts.

Key responsibilities:

- Machine setup and operation:
- Set up and calibrate CNC laser machines according to job specifications.

- Load materials such as black steel, stainless steel, and aluminum (0.5-20mm thickness) into the machine, ensuring proper alignment and secure placement.

- Operate the laser cutter (fiber) to perform cutting or marking tasks as per design specifications.

- Handle small batch sizes, often requiring multiple programs to be executed during a shift.


- Programming and configuration:
- Program the CNC laser machine using appropriate software or manually input parameters to execute specific tasks.

- Adjust machine settings, including power, speed, and focus, to ensure optimal performance and quality.


- Quality control:
- Inspect and measure finished parts to ensure they meet design specifications and quality standards.

- Identify and correct defects or deviations from the intended design, making adjustments as necessary.


- Maintenance and troubleshooting:
- Perform routine maintenance and troubleshoot any issues to ensure the machine operates efficiently.


- Safety protocols:
- Adhere to all safety protocols to maintain a safe working environment.


- Collaboration and communication:

What were looking for:

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to optimize machine usage and streamline work processes.

- High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all tasks.

- Proficiency in setting up, programming, and operating CNC laser machines, including adjusting parameters and making necessary modifications.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.

- Familiarity with instruments and measuring methods for quality control.

- Willingness to work in two shifts.

- CAD training or experience is a plus.

- Proficiency in Finnish or English.

What do we offer?

The position is full-time (Mon-Fri) and a permanent contract with Talent Center. The work is two-shift work, with pay and working conditions determined by the collective agreement for the technology industry.

How to apply:

Submit your application via this advertisement as soon as possible, but no later than October 31st, 2026. The application process will proceed quickly, and we will begin reviewing applications during the application period. For more information about the position, please contact Johanna Mäkelä at johanna.makela@talentcenter.fi on weekdays between 8 a.m. and 4 p.m.
