- Odgovara za svoj rad predradniku na UPOV-u, rukovoditelju OJ u podružnici i direktoru podružnice
  
Stručni uvjeti: KV/SSS tehničkog smjera, vozački ispit, poznavanje rada na računalu.
Na oglas se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad.
  
U prijavi na oglas potrebno je navesti osobne podatke podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te po mogućnosti e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prijavljuje.
Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati.
Uz prijavu, kandidati  su dužni priložiti:
•životopis
•dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (preslika / scan osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili domovnice)
•presliku / scan svjedodžbe,
•vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
  
Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici ili scanu, a prije izbora kandidat/kinja će predočiti izvornik.
Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose se do 30. rujna 2026. godine na adresu VODNE USLUGE d.o.o., Bjelovar, Ferde Rusana 21, s naznakom - „prijava na oglas“ ili e-mailom na adresu: pisarnica@vodneusluge-bj.hr
Potpunom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u oglasu.
Osoba koja nije podnijela pravovremenu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz oglasa, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na oglas.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan/na je u prijavi na oglas pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a može ostvariti pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), dužan/a se u prijavi na oglas pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na oglas dužan/a je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.  Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu je dužan osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.
Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz oglasa bit će proveden usmeni razgovor, a o vremenu i mjestu održavanja usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem kontakt broja telefona odnosno mobitela ili e-mail adrese iz prijave.
Kandidat/kinja koji/a nije pristupio/ila usmenom razgovoru više se ne smatra kandidatom/kinjom u postupku.
O rezultatima oglasa kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni pisanim putem.    
  
VODNE USLUGE d.o.o. pridržavaju pravo poništiti ovaj natječaj u bilo kojem trenutku, bez posebnog obrazloženja.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs.html) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.
FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. jobs.title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
jobs.description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

jobs.title: Servicetekniker - Hele Danmark
jobs.description:
Hvad kan du forvente?

Tesla søger serviceteknikere til vores lokationer i Aalborg, Aarhus, Greve, Hillerød, København-Kastrup, Køge, Odense, Ribe og Søborg.

Arbejd på verdens mest avancerede bil. Få praktisk erfaring med banebrydende elbiler og teknologi, der er med til at forme fremtidens transport.

Stillinger til forskellige erfaringsniveauer – vi finder den rette rolle til dig. Uanset om du er en erfaren tekniker eller er i starten af din karriere, matcher vi dig med en stilling, der passer til dine kompetencer og dine udviklingsmål.

Samarbejde frem for individuelle mål. Vi er ét team med en fælles vision. Succes skabes gennem samarbejde – ikke konkurrence.

Det, du ser ovenfor, er kun begyndelsen!

Er du nysgerrig efter at vide mere? Her er et indblik i, hvad der ellers venter:

  • Invester i din udvikling: 3 ugers intensiv oplæring samt 13 dages årlig efteruddannelse. Vi giver dig de bedste forudsætninger for succes fra første dag og tilbyder løbende uddannelse, så du på sigt kan blive Tesla Master Technician.

  • Forudsigelige arbejdstider: Faste arbejdstider uden forventning om overarbejde.

  • Rene og moderne værksteder: Fuldt udstyrede arbejdsområder med alt det værktøj, du har brug for.

  • Rejsemuligheder: Udbyg dine kompetencer ved at støtte Teslas globale mission.

  • Værktøj: Alt specialiseret Tesla-udstyr stilles til rådighed.

  • Bliv en del af vores succes: Modtag RSU'er (Restricted Stock Units/begrænsede aktieenheder) som belønning for dit bidrag.

Er du klar til at dykke endnu dybere?

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Diagnosticere og reparere den nyeste teknologi: Arbejd med de nyeste elbiler og softwaresystemer – ingen arbejdsdage er ens.

  • Samarbejde med forskellige teams: Arbejd tæt sammen med mobile teknikere, virtuelle supportteams, feltspecialister og øvrige supportfunktioner for at sikre, at alle køretøjer fungerer optimalt.

  • Lær gennem praksis: Udvikl dine kompetencer gennem løbende uddannelse og praktisk erfaring med verdens mest avancerede biler.

  • Støt Teslas mission: Spil en vigtig rolle i at holde vores biler på vejene og hjælpe kunderne med at opleve fremtidens transport.

  • Kundekontakt: Opbyg gode relationer ved at forklare reparationer, besvare spørgsmål og sikre en god kundeoplevelse.

  • Vær på forkant med udviklingen: Få tidlig adgang til nye funktioner, værktøjer og opdateringer, efterhånden som Tesla fortsætter med at udvikle sig.

Kvalifikationer

  • Gode kommunikationsevner: Du kan kommunikere klart og professionelt med både kunder og kolleger om mange forskellige emner.

  • Holdspiller: Du brænder for samarbejde og kontinuerlig forbedring.

  • Gyldigt kørekort: Du skal have et gyldigt kørekort i det land, hvor du søger stillingen.

  • Arbejdstilladelse: Du skal have ret til at arbejde i Danmark.

Lige muligheder og tilgængelighed

Tesla er en arbejdsplads med lige muligheder for alle. Alle kvalificerede ansøgere vil blive vurderet uden hensyn til forhold som f.eks. veteranstatus eller handicap eller andre forhold, der er beskyttet af gældende national eller lokal lovgivning.

Tesla er desuden forpligtet til at tilbyde rimelige tilpasninger til personer med handicap. Hvis du har behov for særlige hensyn på noget tidspunkt under ansættelsesprocessen, bedes du informere din rekrutteringsansvarlige.

Hvis du har behov for en skærmlæser eller anden tilgængelighedsteknologi, kan du hente en gratis kompatibel skærmlæser via Teslas hjemmeside, hvor der også findes en trinvis vejledning. Har du spørgsmål om tilgængelighed eller behov for særlige tilpasninger, kan du kontakte Tesla via den angivne ADA-kontaktadresse.

Beskyttelse af personoplysninger

Beskyttelse af persondata har høj prioritet hos Tesla. Vi indbygger databeskyttelse i vores produkter og betragter det som en central del af vores forretning. Hvis du vil vide mere om, hvordan Tesla indsamler og behandler dine personoplysninger i forbindelse med din ansøgning, kan du læse Teslas erklæring om beskyttelse af personoplysninger for jobansøgere (Tesla Talent Privacy Notice).

jobs.title: Mecánico / Service Technician - Relocation - Northen Europe
jobs.description:
What to Expect

Join Tesla: Bring Your Skills to Northern Europe

Do you want to help build a world of amazing abundance? At Tesla, that’s our mission.

We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made and as a Service Technician, you’ll help deliver an equally groundbreaking service experience to our customers.

Are you ready to take on the challenge and make a real impact in one of the world’s most sustainable and tech-forward regions? We have open roles across Northen Europe.

Why Move to Northen Europe? 

Relocating to Europe isn’t just a career move, it’s a life upgrade. Here’s what you gain:

  • Top-Tier Quality of Life: Consistently ranked among the happiest and safest countries in the world, clean air, green spaces, and safe cities.

  • Sustainable Living: Live in a country where EVs are the norm, public transport is excellent, and sustainability is woven into daily life.

  • Strong Tech & Innovation Ecosystems: Work at the heart of Europe’s clean energy and tech revolution, with access to cutting-edge tools, R&D and global collaboration.

What You’ll Do

Your Role: Service Technician at Tesla

  • Service, repair and improve: Use Tesla-specific software and advanced diagnostic tools to maintain and repair all Tesla vehicles.

  • Ensure top quality: Fix it right the first time. You’ll inspect vehicles with care before return and pre-delivery, because excellence is non-negotiable.

  • Collaborate ,across teams: Work with local and regional colleagues to share knowledge, solve complex issues, and continuously improve the service experience.

  • Grow with us: Access ongoing training, hands-on workshops, and a blended learning program to develop your technical and leadership skills. Your expertise helps shape the future of Tesla service.

What You’ll Bring

 We’re Looking For:

  • Technically experienced: Proven background in vehicle service, repair, or maintenance - automotive, aviation, marine, or industrial.

  • Team player: You thrive in diverse, collaborative environments and value shared success.

  • Flexible & adaptable: Comfortable working in shifts and across time zones to support global operations.

  • Clear communicator: Fluent in English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain technical issues clearly and respectfully.

  • Safe to drive: Valid driver’s license required (for test drives and vehicle handling).

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits

  • A workplace that values you: Safe, clean, innovative, and fun, where your voice matters and your growth is prioritized.

This Is More Than a Job. It’s a Move to the Future.

If you're a skilled technician ready to bring your expertise to a place where sustainability, innovation, and quality of life go hand in hand, apply now.

Join Tesla. Build the future. Live the future.

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran status and disability status, protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

For quick access to screen reading technology compatible with this site click here to download a free compatible screen reader (free step by step tutorial can be found here). Please contact ADA@tesla.com for ADA related questions or to request ADA accommodations.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice .

jobs.title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - Book en samtale i dag!
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en Customer Support Representative?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

Du bliver en del af et mindre, socialt team, hvor personlighed og samarbejde vægtes højt — og hvor fredagsbar, fælles frokost og sociale aktiviteter er en naturlig del af kulturen.

Bidrager til teamet og udviklingen

Du er med til at skabe en god stemning i teamet og bidrager til, at hverdagen fungerer. Du deler viden, støtter nye kolleger og hjælper med at sikre, at teamet arbejder effektivt og med høj kvalitet. Da teamet er lille, har du mulighed for hurtigt at få mere ansvar og udvikle dig i rollen. Du bliver en vigtig del af et fællesskab, hvor man hjælper hinanden, og hvor personlighed og teamfit er afgørende.

Dit ansvar:

  • Kundesupport via e-mail og chat

  • Teknisk vejledning og fejlfinding

  • Overvågning af platformens funktionalitet

  • Rapportering af driftsproblemer

  • Hjælp til kampagner og produktinformation

  • Vidensdeling og støtte til nye kolleger

  • Opdatering af interne systemer og kundehistorik

  • Ad hoc-opgaver efter behov

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Taler og skriver dansk og godt engelsk

  • Udadvendt, social og trives i et ungt team

  • Har øje for detaljer og arbejder struktureret

  • Motiveret for at lære — erfaring er ikke et krav

  • Bonus: Erfaring med kundeservice eller kendskab til casino-/iGaming-branchen

  • Evne til at håndtere flere opgaver og bevare overblikket

Da teamet kun består af otte danske kolleger, lægger man stor vægt på personlighed og på, hvordan du fungerer i fællesskabet. Du skal trives i et miljø, hvor man både arbejder sammen og laver ting sammen uden for arbejdstiden.

Løn og benefits:

  • Årsløn: 27.000 EUR

  • Relocationpakke

  • Løn stiger efter oplæring/kvalifikation

  • Ca. 15 % skat

  • 40 timer om ugen

  • Rotation mellem 08.00 – 21.00

  • 22 feriedage om året

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Socialt arbejdsmiljø med fredagsbar, frokost og teambuilding

  • Danske ledere og et stabilt team

  • Gode lokale deals på fitness, sprogkurser m.m.

Karrieremæssige fordele:

  • Internationale muligheder – Malta er et globalt knudepunkt for tech- og iGaming-industrien, hvilket giver adgang til et bredt netværk af virksomheder og karrieremuligheder.

  • Erhvervserfaring i et voksende marked, en vigtig del af den digitale verden, og erfaring inden for dette felt kan åbne døre til fremtidige roller i tech, compliance og kundeservice.

  • Udvikling af værdifulde færdigheder – Du vil opbygge kompetencer inden for kommunikation, problemløsning og digital sikkerhed, som er eftertragtede på arbejdsmarkedet.

  • Mulighed for karrierevækst – Mange virksomheder i Malta tilbyder interne udviklingsprogrammer og karriereforløb, så du kan avancere i din rolle.

Livet på Malta:

  • Middelhavslivsstil – Malta byder på en afslappet livsstil med smukke strande, historiske byer og en livlig expat-community.

  • Engelsk som arbejdssprog – Engelsk er et af de officielle sprog i Malta, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig både socialt og professionelt.

  • Lav kriminalitet og god sikkerhed – Malta har en af de laveste kriminalitetsrater i Europa, hvilket gør det til et trygt sted at bo.

  • Leveomkostninger – Leveomkostningerne er generelt lavere end i mange andre europæiske lande, især når det kommer til bolig og dagligvarer.

Skat på Malta:

  • Attraktive skatteforhold – Malta har en gunstig skattepolitik for expats, hvor indkomstskat kan være så lav som 15 % for visse erhvervsgrupper.

  • Ingen ejendomsskat – Der er ingen årlig ejendomsskat, hvilket kan være en fordel for dem, der ønsker at investere i bolig.

  • Lav selskabsskat – Hvis du senere ønsker at starte din egen virksomhed, har Malta en af de mest konkurrencedygtige skatteordninger i EU.

Klimaet på Malta:

  • Solrigt året rundt – Malta har over 300 solskinsdage om året, hvilket gør det til et af de mest solrige steder i Europa.

  • Milde vintre – Selv i januar falder temperaturen sjældent under 10°C, hvilket betyder, at du kan nyde udendørslivet året rundt.

  • Varme somre – Sommeren kan blive varm med temperaturer op til 35°C, men den friske havbrise gør det behageligt.

At arbejde på Malta giver dig ikke kun en spændende karrierevej, men også en fantastisk livsstil i et solrigt og dynamisk miljø. Lyder det som noget for dig?

jobs.title: Staff Professional Services Operations Manager
Support Engineer I (NYC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our NYC (SoHo) office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Self-driving Company https://replit.com/blog/self-driving-company

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
   
    

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

 - Operating Principles https://blog.replit.com/operating-principles

 - Reasons not to work at Replit https://blog.replit.com/reasons-not-to-join-replit



To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.

HOW TO APPLY? PLEASE SEND YOUR CV TO: EURES.SELECCIO.SOC@GENCAT.CAT REFERENCE: SKI PATROLLER IF YOU ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SLOPE SAFETY AND RESCUE OPERATIONS FOR INJURED SKIERS, WE ARE LOOKING FOR A SKI PATROLLERS. YOUR ROLE WILL BE CRUCIAL FOR RISK PREVENTION, MEDICAL CARE, AND EVACUATIONS ACROSS THE SKI RESORT. IF YOU WANT TO JOIN A TEAM WORKING IN A SPECTACULAR ENVIRONMENT WHERE YOUR LOVE FOR THE MOUNTAINS AND TECHNICAL SKILLS MAKE A REAL DIFFERENCE, WE WANT TO MEET YOU! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - SLOPE OPENING & MARKING: INSPECT TRAIL CONDITIONS, PREPARE TERRAIN, AND SET UP NECESSARY SAFETY SIGNAGE AND MARKERS. - FIRST AID & RESCUE: PROVIDE PROMPT CARE TO INJURED SKIERS, STABILIZE THEM, AND CONDUCT RESCUE TOBOGGAN/SLED EVACUATIONS. - RISK PREVENTION & CONTROL: MONITOR SNOW CONDITIONS AND EXECUTE SAFETY PROTOCOLS, INCLUDING AVALANCHE HAZARD MITIGATION. - CUSTOMER SERVICE: ENSURE COMPLIANCE WITH FIS RULES AND ADVISE SKIERS ON ROUTES, WEATHER, TERRAIN STATUS, AND AVALANCHE RISKS. - END-OF-DAY SWEEPS: PERFORM FINAL SLOPE CHECKS AT CLOSING TO ENSURE ALL GUESTS HAVE SAFELY LEFT THE MOUNTAIN. CANDIDATE PROFILE: - EDUCATION & CERTIFICATION: OFFICIAL SKI PATROLLER CERTIFICATION AND/OR EMERGENCY MEDICAL TECHNICIAN (EMT) QUALIFICATION, OR EQUIVALENT MOUNTAIN RESCUE TRAINING, IS HIGHLY VALUED. - EXPERIENCE: NO PRIOR EXPERIENCE REQUIRED, THOUGH 1¿2 SEASONS IN SKI RESORTS OR RESCUE SERVICES IS A PLUS. - SKIING ABILITY: EXPERT / ADVANCED. MUST BE ABLE TO DESCEND ANY TRAIL AND NAVIGATE ALL SNOW CONDITIONS WHILE CARRYING OR OPERATING RESCUE GEAR. - LANGUAGES: FLUENT SPANISH, KNOWLEDGE OF CATALAN, FRENCH, OR ENGLISH IS HIGHLY VALUED. - KEY STRENGTHS: ABILITY TO REMAIN CALM UNDER PRESSURE, EXCELLENT PHYSICAL CONDITION, STRONG TEAMWORK, EMPATHY WITH INJURED GUESTS, AND AN UNCOMPROMISING COMMITMENT TO SAFETY. OTHER INFORMATION: - THE COMPANY HAS SPECIFIC ACCOMMODATION OPTIONS WITH TRANSPARENT ASSIGNMENT CRITERIA FOR TEMPORARY STAFF. WE WILL PROVIDE YOU WIT.

jobs.title: Tarjoilukeittiön keittiötyöntekijä Keisarinnaan
jobs.description:
**Oletko se ihminen, jonka ansiosta Keisarinnan tarjoilukeittiö toimii?**

Me uskomme, että jokaisessa keittiössä on yksi ihminen, joka pitää langat käsissään. Hän huomaa, jos jokin asia on jäämässä tekemättä. Hän pitää huolen siitä, että asiat tapahtuvat ajallaan. Hän löytää sujuvamman tavan tehdä asioita ja nauttii siitä, kun arki rullaa – ei siksi, että hän juoksisi sinne tänne, vaan siksi, että hänen työnsä sujuu hyvällä mielellä. Nyt etsimme tätä ihmistä meille.

**Kototiimi kasvaa vauhdilla – ja tarvitsemme kasvun mahdollistajan keittiöön**

Tällä hetkellä Kototiimillä on kaksi hoivakotia (kurkkaa www.kototiimi.fi). Kolmas avaa ovensa lokakuussa. Kasvun mukana lisääntyvät myös asiakkaat, tarjoiltavat ateriat ja välipalat, tiski, herkkujen tarve ja juhlien suunnittelu jne. Siksi tarvitsemme Keisarinnan keittiöön avainhenkilön – ihmisen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus pysyy hallinnassa.

Tässä tehtävässä et ole vain osa keittiötä. Olet Keisarinnan sydän.

**Mitä työsi käytännössä on?**

Työsi tärkein vastuu on saada päivittäiset ateriat turvallisesti ja kauniisti tarjolle (ateriat tulevat valmiina eli emme valmista lounasta ja päivällistä), pitää keittiö siistinä, suunnitella välipaloja ja leivonnaisia sekä huolehtia, että tarvikkeita on riittävästi. Toki myös keittiön omavalvonnasta huolehtiminen on vastuullasi. Huolehdit siitä, että tarjoilukeittiö toimii täsmällisesti, ajallaan ja laadukkaasti. Sinulle tarkkuus ei ole rasite, vaan tapa tehdä työtä. Toimit myös osana Keisarinnan tiimiä. Perehdytät, neuvot ja kehität toimintaa aterioiden ja keittiön näkökulmasta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Haluamme, että osaaminen kasvaa koko tiimissä – ei vain yhdellä ihmisellä. Kaikki auttavat toisiaan, koska meillä yksi asia yhdistää kaikkia: **Ketään ei jätetä yksin.**

**Me innostumme ihmisistä, jotka kehittävät.**

Ehkä huomaat usein miettiväsi:\_"Tämän voisi tehdä vähän fiksummin."\_Silloin saatat viihtyä meillä erinomaisesti. Emme etsi ihmistä, joka vain ylläpitää nykyisiä toimintatapoja. Etsimme ihmistä, joka uskaltaa kysyä, voisiko tämän tehdä paremmin. Kasvavassa yrityksessä mikään ei ole valmiiksi kiveen hakattua. Juuri siksi pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi Kototiimin Keisarinna rakentuu.

**Millainen sinä olet?**

Pidät järjestyksestä. Nautit siitä, että asiat ovat järjestyksessä ja tehtynä ajallaan. Rakastat työskennellä keittiössä. Vaikka meillä et valmista ruokaa alusta asti, pidät leipomisesta ja muusta värkkäämisestä ruoan ympärillä.

Sinulla on kokemusta keittiötyöstä, leipomisesta ja keittiöhygieniasta. Tai ehkä polkusi on ollut aivan toisenlainen. Meille tärkeintä on asenne.

**Mitä saat meiltä?**

Saat vakituisen työn yrityksessä, joka kasvaa voimakkaasti ja jossa omaan työhön voi oikeasti vaikuttaa. Saat vastuuta, luottamusta ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Saat työyhteisön, jossa autetaan toisia, iloitaan onnistumisista ja tehdään töitä yhteisen tavoitteen eteen. Ja mikä tärkeintä – saat työn, jolla on valtava merkitys asiakkaillemme.

Vaikka et työskentelisi päivittäin asukkaidemme kanssa, vaikutat siihen, että heidän arkensa toimii. Kun keittiö toimii hyvin, koko hoivakotiyhteisö toimii hyvin.

**Jos tunnistit itsesi...**

...älä jää miettimään, täytätkö jokaisen kohdan. Jos ajattelet, että voisit olla juuri se ihminen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus toimii vähän paremmin, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Tule rakentamaan Kototiimin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta. Meillä tärkeimmät työt eivät aina näy ulospäin – mutta niiden vaikutus näkyy joka päivä.

jobs.title: Doctoral researcher in computational weld mechanics
jobs.description:
Do you want to build a research career in computational weld mechanics? Join LUT University as a doctoral researcher and become part of an international research team developing advanced simulation methods for welded high-strength steel structures.

What your work will be like

Your work will focus on the analysis of local heat-affected zone (HAZ) behaviour in welded high-strength steels through computational weld mechanics (CWM) and phase-transformation modelling.
The research combines thermo-metallurgical and phase-transformation modelling, simulation of microstructural evolution in weld heat-affected zones, and modelling of local mechanical properties such as hardness, strength and strain-hardening behaviour. In addition, the work includes experimental characterisation of welded joints using microstructural, thermal and mechanical measurements and the validation of predictive models for performance-driven design of welded structures.

You will contribute to the development of next-generation simulation methods capable of accurately predicting local property variations in welded high-strength fossil-free steel structures.

You will be part of the Welding Technology Unit and the Steel Structures Unit at the LUT School of Energy Systems. Approximately 25 researchers are involved in these units, which collaborate closely with national and international partner universities, such as University of Oulu (Finland), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (Sweden) and Chemnitz University of Technology (Germany).

What we expect from you

You have a master's degree (M.Sc. or equivalent) in a relevant field such as mechanical engineering, materials engineering, welding engineering, computational mechanics, or another relevant discipline, and the ability and motivation to complete the doctoral studies within their normative duration (i.e. four years).

A solid background in numerical modelling, materials science, solid mechanics, finite element methods, programming, and/or welding technology is considered beneficial. Success in this position requires the ability to work independently, communicate findings clearly, and collaborate effectively within our international research community. Proficiency in English, both written and spoken, is required for performing the duties of this role.

We expect a willingness to travel, as the position includes project-related travel within Finland, participation in international conferences, and opportunities for research mobility with partner universities in Europe.

The selected candidate must submit an application for the right to complete doctoral studies with all required appendices to the LUT Doctoral School within the first two months of the employment relationship.

What we offer

At LUT, you will have the opportunity to develop your scientific expertise and research skills. Our experienced supervisors will guide you, and you will benefit from professional development opportunities.

The position is based at the Lappeenranta campus, and you are expected to be regularly present on site.

The employment relationship will start with a one-year term (including a six-month trial period) and may be extended for up to three additional years, depending on the progress of your studies and research.

The work starts in December 2026. The start date is negotiable. Working hours are flexible, supporting work-life balance, with a total of 1,612 annual working hours in accordance with the collective agreement for Finnish universities.

The salary is determined according to the Finnish university salary system (requirement level 2). The starting salary is approximately EUR 3,100 per month, depending on experience and qualifications.

Interested? Please submit your application by 15 October 2026 at 23:59 (UTC+2h). Fill out the online application form and attach the following documents in English and in PDF format:

- A cover letter describing your motivation and suitability specifically for this position, based on your expertise acquired during studies and potential prior work experience

- A curriculum vitae (CV) following the guidelines of the [Finnish Advisory Board on Research Integrity](https://tenk.fi/sites/default/files/2021-06/TENK_CV_template_2020.pdf)

- Scanned copies of your original bachelors and masters degree certificates and transcripts of records; if the original documents are not in English or Finnish, each document must be accompanied by an official certified translation into English (or Finnish). If the degree is unfinished, please provide an official estimate of your graduation.

- Contact details of two references (if available)

- A list of publications (if any)

Each attachment field accepts only one file. If you wish to submit multiple files, please combine them into a single PDF before uploading.

We will review applications on a rolling basis. Please ensure that your application includes all required documents and is submitted through the recruitment system.

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tuomas Skriko (tuomas.skriko@lut.fi, +358 50 470 6518) or Assistant Professor Antti Ahola (antti.ahola@lut.fi, +358 50 475 2825), preferably by email. You can also reach them by phone on 25 September 2026 and 9 October 2026 from 14:00 to 15:00 (UTC+2).

Read more about [LUT as an employer](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/lut-employer) and the [LUT Doctoral School](https://www.lut.fi/en/research/doctoral-school).

Explore [information for international staff](https://www.lut.fi/en/about-us/come-work-us/international-staff-and-visitors)

jobs.title: Kreativ og engageret kantinemedarbejder til Campus Kalundborg
jobs.description:
Vi søger en kantinemedarbejder, der brænder for arbejdet i en kantine. Du behøver ikke være faglært, men det er vigtigt, at du har interesse for mad, service og samarbejde. Har du lyst til at være en del af et udviklende, solidarisk og omsorgsfuldt arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejdergruppen lægger vægt på trivsel og samhørighed?

På Professionshøjskolen Absalon har vi et ønske om at have levende campusmiljøer og at sætte vores studerende i centrum. Der er mange internationale studerende på Campus Kalundborg, hvorfor kommunikation på engelsk er en del af dagligdagen.

Alle campusser på Absalon har tilknyttet en kantine, hvor studerende og ansatte hver dag har mulighed for at købe et sundt og velsmagende måltid. Kantinerne har et stort fokus på, at deres arbejde ikke kun er madproduktion og salg. Kantinen er det uformelle samlingspunkt på campus og altid et rart sted at være. Vi er løbende i dialog rundt om buffeten i kantinen og har dialogmøder med de studerende. Dette gør vi for at sikre at det måltid, som vi serverer for de studerende, falder i deres smag, og giver dem lyst til at samles i vores kantinemiljøer.

Din profil
Du skal som kantinemedarbejder på Campus Kalundborg være serviceminded, arbejdsom og have lyst til at bidrage positivt til hverdagen i kantinen. Erfaring fra kantine, køkken eller servicefag er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Derudover skal du have lyst til at være i et miljø med mange glade studerende. Vi synes derfor, at det er vigtigt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Bæredygtigt fokus. Du har erfaring med at være i en kantine, hvor der er fokus på økologi, bæredygtighed og at madspild bliver mindsket. Derudover har du lyst og evne til at dele dine gode ideer, samt suger til dig, når du selv har mulighed for at opnå ny viden.

Besidder overblik og fleksibilitet. I en hektisk hverdag, hvor der er mange opgaver at planlægge og følge op på, formår du at træffe velovervejede beslutninger, omsætte dem til handling og samtidig bevare overblikket. Din tilgang til opgaverne er systematisk, og du løser dem med nøjagtighed og omhu. Du udviser ansvarsfølelse, er serviceminded og engageret både i forhold til opgaverne og i samarbejdet med andre. Du omfavner forandringer og møder dem med en positiv indstilling.

Gode samarbejdsevner. Du evner at arbejde sammen med mange forskellige mennesker på tværs af faggrupper. Du har også evner og lyst til en hverdag, der rummer det brede arbejdsmarked, hvilket fx omfatter kolleger, der er ansat i virksomhedspraktik.

Erfaring med LEAN som arbejdsredskab. Du har med egne øjne set eksempler på, hvordan det ved hjælp af LEAN er muligt at frigive tid og ressourcer til andre vigtige gøremål i en travl hverdag.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • taler og skriver dansk og engelsk
  • har kendskab til Microsoft 365 på brugerniveau
  • gerne har erfaring fra lignende stillinger i en kantine eller et køkken.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Som kantinemedarbejder er dine opgaver følgende:

Deltage i kantinens drift, som kræver evnen til at jonglere med flere opgaver samtidig. Du hjælper med den daglige produktion, klargøring af buffet, lettere køkkenopgaver, opfyldning, oprydning, opvask, udbringning af mødeforplejning og betjening af gæster i kantinen.

Udvikling i dagligdagen spiller en afgørende rolle, hvor du aktivt bidrager til at udvikle arbejdsgange og udtænke innovative metoder til anvendelse af appelsinskræller eller broccolistokke i vores stræben efter et endnu mere bæredygtigt fokus.

Sørge for kursister og gæster er afgørende på vores campus, hvor vi afholder kurser og konferencer for både interne og eksterne virksomheder og organisationer. Under disse begivenheder spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at kursister og gæster får passende forplejning til rette tid, hvilket bidrager til en førsteklasses serviceoplevelse.

Du får ansættelsessted på vores Campus i Kalundborg, men på sigt skal du forvente at have en ugentlig dag i vores kantine i Holbæk.

Dine kolleger
Kantinerne på Absalon er en del af Facility Service. Vi arbejder i teams og selvom vi er spredt på forskellige campusser, samarbejder vi på tværs og går op i at skabe holdånd og fællesskab, uanset om du arbejder i Kalundborg, Slagelse, Vordingborg eller på en af de øvrige campusser.

I kantinen på Campus Kalundborg er vi et team bestående af en elev, to medarbejdere og en leder. Vi går op i kvalitet, at der er en uformel omgangstone, og så skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • For dig der er ufaglært, ligger en forventet månedlig løn mellem 24.200 kr. og 24.900 kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 16% For dig der er faglært, ligger en forventet månedlig løn mellem 26.100 kr. og 26.300 kr. Hertil kommer et pensionsbidrag på 15% eller 18,4% alt efter din uddannelsesbaggrund. Alt efter erfaring og baggrund kan der evt. forhandles kvalifikationstillæg.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og vi vil gerne have at du begynder senest den 1. december 2026
  • Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte kantineleder Søren Loui Frydensberg, der kan træffes dagligt fra kl. 13.00 - 15.00 på tlf.: 7248 2253 eller mail skre@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her: https://phabsalon.dk/job-i-absalon/ledige-stillinger eller ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 13. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtale d. 21. oktober og 2. samtale d. 22. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer
jobs.description:
**OPEN CALL FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST FOR SECONDED NATIONAL EXPERTS AT THE EUROPEAN CHEMICALS AGENCY (ECHA), HELSINKI**

Seconded National Experts (SNEs) are drawn from the civil services of EU countries. They bring their unique skills and knowledge to ECHA for a period of time before taking the experience acquired during their stay at the Agency back to their home administration.

ECHA offers job opportunities for **Seconded National Experts (SNEs)** in the following profile:

**Profile Reference:** ECHA/SNE/2026/002

**Profile Title:** Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer

**1\. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS**

Candidates for secondment must:

· Have current employment in the national, regional or local public sector or international civil service. Alternatively candidates may be employed in a non-profit or voluntary sector;

· Hold a university degree in a field relevant to the areas of work described in this call;

· Be a national of an EU or EFTA Member State or a candidate country as decided by the Council;

· Be able to communicate in written and spoken English as this is the working language of ECHA.

**2\. SECONDMENT**

The secondment will be subject to an exchange of letters between the Head of People and Development of ECHA and the applicants employer. The duration of the first secondment is a maximum of one year. This period may be renewed for a maximum of three additional years.

Seconded National Experts remain in the service of their employer throughout the period of their secondment. The sending organisation must continue remunerating the SNE, who will thus benefit from social security coverage. During their secondment, SNEs will receive subsistence allowances and reimbursement of expenses as set out in the Rules on the secondment of national experts to the European Chemicals Agency (Decision ED-0050).

The SNE Rules

**3\. PROFILE**

**Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer; ref.: ECHA/SNE/2026/002**

Our ideal candidate is a communications professional with experience gained working in a national authority, national ministry, European institution or European agency. Comfortable in a changing environment, you are adaptable, resilient and have good interpersonal and networking skills. You are curious about developments in your field and communications more broadly.

The Unit is responsible for ECHAs communications activities, including press relations, external and internal communications, social media, digital communications and its website. We focus on delivering professional proactive, clear and strategic communications services, that support the Agency's activities and promote ECHAs work and achievements.

**Job description**:

The Seconded National Expert will work in the Communications Unit – G3.

The Communications Officer will contribute to the Units daily interaction with internal and external stakeholders. The jobholder will also be responsible for relations with internal business areas on specific regulatory topics in support of ECHAs external communications strategy. The role for this profile will be assigned according to the Units needs and the jobholders competencies.

Duties will include, depending on needs:

**External Communications:**

Drafting press releases, briefings, speeches etc.;

Developing content for ECHAs website;

Dealing with press queries, interviews and briefings;

Supporting senior management with media appearances;

Organizing and supporting events for external stakeholders;

Support the production of webinars and videos;

Support the management of the Agency's corporate communication channels and social media presence; ,

Acting as a spokesperson when required; and

Working with colleagues across ECHA to determine communication priorities and key messages to be delivered to internal and external stakeholders.

**Internal Communications:**

Cooperating with colleagues in determining communications priorities;

Content development for ECHAs Intranet;

Organizing and supporting internal staff events; and

General support to internal communication initiatives.

**Project Work**

The Unit is responsible for a number of ECHA wide projects, where input may be required, including:

Building a new website;

Implementing the new ECHA corporate identity;

ECHAs 2027 Conference – 20-21 May 2027;

ECHAs 20th Anniversary 1 June 2027-31 May 2028;

Chairing the EU Agencies Heads of Communications & Information Network – 1 March 2027-28 February 2028;

**Requirements:**

Successful completion of a full course of university studies attested by a degree, where the normal duration of university education is three (3) years or more.

Of your total professional experience, at least one (1) year must be in a field or fields relevant to the areas of work mentioned above e.g. for example, external/internal communications or stakeholder relations.

Only qualifications issued by EU Member State authorities or EEA authorities and qualifications recognised as equivalent by the relevant EU or EEA Member State authorities will be accepted.

**Selection criteria:**

If you meet the requirements set out above, you will be assessed on the basis of the following selection criteria. The candidates who are judged to be the most suitable on the basis of the selection criteria will be invited to a (remote) interview.

The following will be considered as **assets**:

· Ability to communicate effectively in English at all levels both orally and in writing;

· Experience of working in a communications/stakeholder relations function in a complex regulatory environment; and

· Demonstrated understanding of the link between your current experience, the Communications Officers role and ECHAs strategic priorities.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor in Business Analytics (tenure track) / Biträdande professor (nivå 1), biträdande professor (nivå 2) eller professor inom affärsanalytik (tenure track)
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

Hanken School of Economics invites applications for a tenure-track position in Business Analytics at the level of Assistant Professor, Associate Professor, or Full Professor

starting on 1 January 2027, or as otherwise agreed, by 1 September 2027 at the latest. The position is based in Helsinki within the subject of Statistics, which is part of the Department of Finance and Economics.

The position is part of Hankens tenure-track system and is open to researchers with the potential for an outstanding academic career. If the position is filled at the Assistant Professor or Associate Professor level, the successful candidate will have the opportunity to advance through evaluations that consider merits across all relevant areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).

Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in Swedish and English. The Statistics unit, which collaborates closely with Finance and Information Systems, conducts high-quality research on financial time series. The subject seeks to strengthen its teaching and research in the application of machine learning and business analytics. The subject offers education at the Bachelors, Masters, and doctoral levels.

The Department provides a strong research environment, reflected in the growing scope and breadth of its research activities. We value high-quality research with relevance to business and economics, as demonstrated by publications in highly ranked academic journals.

Requirements

The applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants for the current position are required to have a fluent command of both English and Swedish. Teaching in Swedish is expected as part of the position's responsibilities.

Applicants on the assistant professor level should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of their doctorate) with a quantitative research orientation (e.g., business analytics, data science, machine learning, management science, statistics, econometrics, quantitative economics, or applied mathematics). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research in key areas relevant to the position, including Business Analytics and the potential to provide high-quality teaching.

In addition to the requirements for an assistant professor, applicants for the associate professor level are expected to have demonstrated internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position, high levels in teaching and contributed through institutional service and societal impact.

Applicants for full professor must demonstrate that she or he is an internationally recognised researcher with continued internationally high levels of research within the scientific field of the position. A professor is also expected to demonstrate continued high levels in teaching, institutional service and societal impact. In addition, academic leadership, experience of PhD supervision, experience and success in applying competitive research funding, international research cooperation, academic expert assignments, and experience of service within an academic department, faculty and / or university are expected.

Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide high-quality academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and participate in service to Hanken, the academic community, and society.

The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant own expertise.

Salary

The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications and performance. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.

For more Information

For additional information, please contact Chair of the Department Committee, Professor Anders Löflund, anders.loflund@hanken.fi.

General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).

Recruitment process and timeline

The application deadline is October 18th, 2026. Candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.

How to apply

The application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:

- Cover letter in which the applicant specifies the position for which they are applying (professor, associate professor, or assistant professor)
- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.
- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.
- List of publications (with the most significant publications highlighted; maximum 10 for full professor applicants and maximum 5 for associate and assistant professor applicants. Applicants at the associate professor and full professor levels should additionally submit up to five publications for assessment.

jobs.title: Salin vuoropäällikkö VENN Joensuu
jobs.description:
Primary location:
JOENSUU

VENNissä on paikka auki positiiviselle, määrätietoiselle, ratkaisukeskeiselle ja kehitysmyönteiselle ravintola-alan ammattilaiselle. Meillä työt tehdään täydellä sydämellä, hymyä ja naurua unohtamatta.

Jos meiltä kysytään, syntyy paras vuoropäällikön resepti seuraavista ainesosista:Olet oma-aloitteinen ja tehokas henkilö, joka motivoi tiimiään positiivisen kautta. Omaat vahvan asiakaslähtöisen asenteen ja luontaisen palon asiakaspalveluun. Ymmärrät tulostavoitteellisuutta ja tunnuslukuja tai olet innokas oppimaan niistä. Arvostat sekä omaa että työkaverisi työpanosta ja sytyt siitä, kun saat pidettyä langat käsissäsi. Pidät kiireisestä työympäristöstä ja olet kiinnostunut alan trendeistä. Sinä pystyt myös yksintyöskentelyyn. Katsomme hakijalle eduksi aiemman esihenkilökokemuksen. Tehtävän hoitaminen vaatii suoritettua hygienia- ja anniskelupassia sekä hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.

Työsuhde on vakituinen, 90 h/ 3 viikkoa tai sopimuksen mukaan. Työt alkavat heti kun löydämme oikean henkilön tiimiimme. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijöillämme on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamistaan. Lisäksi saat käyttöösi erinomaiset PKO:n ja S-ryhmän henkilökuntaeduthttps://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

  Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og er som udgangspunkt et barselsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse. Der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Trindsøvej i Aarhus.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aarhus og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aarhus". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores afdelingsdirektør Niels Juul Jørgensen på tlf. 4040 2489 eller mail nju@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.title: Secretary / Office Worker
jobs.description:
**Secretary / Office Worker**

**Employer:** Legal Consulting Aram / Aram Farokhizadeh **Location:** Turku, Finland **Duration of employment:** Fixed-term, 1 year **Working hours:** Average of 37.5 hours per week **Salary:** €2,050/month

**Brief Description of the Position**

We are looking for a secretary for a variety of office and customer service duties in Turku. The work involves serving customers and assisting them with various office and administrative matters.

**Job Description**

The employees duties include a variety of office, secretarial and customer service tasks in accordance with the employers instructions.

The duties may include, for example:

- managing appointments and providing customer service

- advising and guiding customers

- assisting customers with various documents and applications

- preparing reports and other office documents

- performing computer-based office tasks

- using Word, Excel and other office software

- handling emails and other communications

- other reasonable office and secretarial duties related to the employers business.


The position requires accuracy, responsibility and good customer service skills.

**Language Skills**

A **good command of Finnish is important** for the position, as the work involves customer service, providing guidance and handling various documents.

**Knowledge of Persian is considered an advantage**, as the office has many Persian-speaking customers.

Other language skills are also considered an advantage.

**Experience and Skills**

Previous experience in office or customer service work is desirable. Applicants should have good computer skills, be familiar with common office software, and have good communication and customer service skills.

The position also requires the ability to remain calm in different customer service situations, as well as a careful and responsible approach to work.

**Working Hours and Salary**

Regular working hours are an average of 37.5 hours per week and an average of 7.5 hours per day. Weekly working hours may vary, but they will average 37.5 hours per week in accordance with the Finnish Working Hours Act.

The salary is **€2,050 per month**.

For work performed between 6:00 p.m. and 9:00 p.m., an evening work allowance will be paid in accordance with the employment contract.

**Confidentiality and Reliability**

The employee is expected to be reliable, careful and responsible. Customer information handled in the course of the work is confidential, and the employee must comply with confidentiality obligations and requirements concerning the processing of personal data.

**Employment**

The employment relationship will initially be fixed-term for one year. The start date of the employment will be determined in accordance with the terms of the employment contract.

If the employment relationship proceeds well and the need for labour continues, the intention is to potentially continue the employment relationship on a permanent basis after the fixed-term period.
